sources.title: Characterization Testing
sources.author: Michael Feathers
sources.claim: Actual behavior is not desired correctness; formatText example and users depending on removed behavior.
sources.limits: Open full original; no effect-size evidence.

sources.title: A Philosophy of Software Design vs Clean Code
sources.author: John Ousterhout and Robert Martin
sources.claim: Deep interfaces lower necessary knowledge; over-decomposition can hide side effects and entangle methods; both authors disagree about best decomposition.
sources.limits: Read introduction, method-length discussion and PrimeGenerator example; pedagogical not controlled trial.

sources.title: Branch By Abstraction
sources.author: Martin Fowler
sources.claim: Move consumers to an abstraction; replace one supplier incrementally; compare behind seam and remove supplier/possibly abstraction.
sources.limits: Full text; does not prove Hima needs a new seam.

sources.title: Patterns of Legacy Displacement
sources.author: Ian Cartwright, Rob Horn, James Lewis
sources.claim: Large replacement treadmill and unchanged work patterns can defeat modernization; business and technical seams must be considered together.
sources.limits: Anonymous consulting experience, no controlled denominator; do not use 50 percent as measured fact.

sources.title: Transitional Architecture
sources.author: Ian Cartwright, Rob Horn, James Lewis
sources.claim: Temporary adapters have explicit removal cost; choose paths by delivery/risk value and remove obsolete components.
sources.limits: Middleware replacement case; not empirical effect size.

sources.title: Architecture Tradeoff Analysis Method Collection
sources.author: CMU SEI
sources.claim: Business drivers become prioritized quality scenarios and risk/sensitivity/tradeoff findings; full ATAM typically 3-4 days.
sources.limits: Hima one-page scenario review is an adaptation, not completed ATAM or system correctness proof.

sources.title: Quality Attribute Workshops Third Edition
sources.author: Barbacci et al., CMU SEI
sources.claim: Prioritized refined quality scenarios clarify requirements; designed before architecture.
sources.limits: Borrow scenario specificity; do not recommend full early-life-cycle workshop for existing Hima.

sources.title: Fitness function-driven development
sources.author: Thoughtworks
sources.claim: Architecture goals expressed as measurable checks in delivery feedback; recovery/resilience and observability examples.
sources.limits: Illustrative metric thresholds such as 90 percent coverage are not validated defaults; documentation existence checks can be shallow.

sources.title: Adam Tornhill on Software Design X-Rays
sources.author: Adam Tornhill, first-person podcast transcript
sources.claim: Hotspot combines complexity and frequent change, contextualizes priorities; trends more informative than raw scores.
sources.limits: Vendor founder testimony; do not treat 80 percent remarks or positive experience as prevalence/effect size.

sources.title: Change coupling: visualize the cost of change
sources.author: Adam Tornhill
sources.claim: Co-changing implementation entities can reveal dependencies absent from static imports. Author explicitly says cochange is neither good nor bad; production code and its tests coevolving is expected healthy coupling.
sources.limits: Vendor evidence; cochange needs commit-content inspection; no recommendation to buy/install tool.

sources.title: Technical Debt Friction for Maintenance Prioritization: An Industrial Multi-Case Study
sources.author: Tverdal et al.
sources.claim: Contextual industrial walkthroughs: hotspots/coupling do not fully capture experienced change burden; complementary evidence matters.
sources.limits: Abstract only; exclude quantitative effects and sample claims; accepted industry track per authors metadata.
